title: Dose-Related Urinary Metabolic Alterations of a Combination of Quercetin and Resveratrol-Treated High-Fat Diet Fed Rats - PubMed
abstract:
A combination of quercetin and resveratrol reduces obesity in high-fat diet-fed rats by modulation of gut microbiota.
Most herbal polyphenols and flavonoids reveals multiple ameliorative benefits for obesity caused by chronic metabolic disorders.
